verdict.rationale: SigNoz has a programmatic API, with service accounts for automation, and its official MCP server covers querying telemetry plus managing dashboards, alert rules, saved views and notification channels. That spans much of the UI surface, but nothing documents full UI-to-API parity, and no OpenAPI spec was found at any probed path. Missing for 10: an explicit claim or reference showing every UI action is available via the API, a published API reference or OpenAPI spec, API coverage for areas like log pipelines, roles and public dashboard publishing, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Service accounts provide a secure way to grant programmatic API access to SigNoz without tying credentials to individual users.
any non-human system that needs to interact with the SigNoz API
Use natural language to query metrics, traces, and logs; investigate alerts; and manage dashboards, alert rules, saved views, and notification channels.
